findings.title: A walker whose EnterPortal job is interrupted stops holding the dungeon open
findings.detail: The new wait at DungeonSite.cs:169 holds only while the pawn's current job is EnterPortal to the exit. SendThroughExit gives that job once, and the follower has already left its lord, so if anything interrupts the job (a fight, a mental break), the next ShouldRemoveMapNow returns true and that animal or follower is lost with the map. This is rarer than the build-46 bug but the same outcome. The opinion part (how often this happens in play) is not cited.

findings.title: lastEyed and eyeingSince are never pruned
findings.detail: Dead, departed or joined dwellers stay as keys until the map is removed. The leak is small because it is per map and not saved. Removing the predator from both dictionaries when it stops being a dweller would keep them tidy.

checked: ShouldRemoveMapNow walker loop: CurJob is non-null when CurJobDef is EnterPortal; IsFollower checks for a null map (DungeonDwellers.cs:28)
The walker wait is bounded: JobDriver_EnterPortal fails if the exit is despawned, can't be entered or can't be reached, and only SendThroughExit gives the job (DungeonDwellers.cs:81)
Pawns that came through but haven't been moved out are still handled by MoveArrivedOut in Notify_MyMapAboutToBeRemoved (DungeonSite.cs:189-190)
